text: Undecidability means software verification is pointless.
explanation: The seL4 microkernel and the CompCert C compiler are formally verified. Undecidability says no *automatic* procedure works for every program; it says nothing against proving a specific program correct with human guidance. What it does mean practically is that no tool can be sound, complete and terminating at once — every static analyser has given up one of the three, and knowing which explains its behaviour.
